feedback: The planned sample targets are not completed samples. Use the governed planned-sample value if it is available; otherwise use a Gap and do not claim completion. Add the planned use of 13 unnamed EQ-5D bolt-on questions with the exact source label and no inferred identities.

Remove VALUATION_METHOD_EVALUATION as a purpose. Model comparison and selection are procedures for the stated value-set-development purpose; keep them as ModelUse records. Do not map the Taiwan traditional-Chinese EQ-5D-5L edition to the base instrument unless the reviewed registry supplies that exact child identity.

Do not use STUDIED_CONDITION for EQ-5D profiles, correction variants, or loss-aversion reference points. Keep profiles and reference points in TaskDesign. Use COMPARATOR only for retained analysed alternatives.

Keep StudyPart records flat and give each substantive part complete effective design axes. Remove IMPLEMENTATION_EVALUATION, the implementation-object use, and the implementation outcome because the study evaluates services with routine PROM data, not implementation. Add the 2,285-record source cohort, 107 excluded same-day records, and restriction from 14 service types to three with sufficient samples.

Set the StudyPart item's own part_id to null. Add attrition counts: 248 left before arm assignment, 1,742 failed the comprehension quiz, and 422 left during tasks or follow-up; 2,577 of 4,989 recruits entered the psychometric analysis.

Remove METHOD_OR_PROTOCOL_QUALITY as a purpose. The paper develops a checklist but does not apply it to evaluate a method or protocol. Add translatability and cultural context as an additional item-selection consideration, not as a twenty-third checklist criterion.

Give the harmonization part complete effective temporal, comparison, and allocation design axes. Remove rank-3 IMPLEMENTATION_EVALUATION: draft-content and task-feasibility testing is not implementation evaluation. Add the recruitment constraint: children with health conditions were difficult to recruit, and UK phase 2 used schoolchildren because separate NHS approval would delay recruitment.

Add the two subthreshold communalities: 0.436 for having enough money to cover treatment and 0.380 for feeling financially stressed. Add the five-patient pilot and T1/T2 follow-up intervals of 5.8 and 11.6 weeks. Preserve the supported administration conflict.

Keep StudyParts flat. Change the isiXhosa translation target, translation protocol, forward/back translation, and cognitive interviews from SOURCE_STUDY_ACTIVITY to current-study contexts. Add secondary purpose TRANSLATION_AND_CULTURAL_ADAPTATION. Do not map the isiXhosa three-level EQ-TIPS edition to the base instrument unless the reviewed registry supplies that exact child identity.

Change the primary family to HEALTH_OUTCOME_RESEARCH. Make OUTCOME_DESCRIPTION purpose rank 1 and keep MEASUREMENT_PROPERTY_EVALUATION as secondary. The stated aim, most analyses, and conclusion concern caregiver HRQoL, burden, and determinants; EQ-5D discrimination is secondary.

Give every substantive StudyPart complete effective design axes. Parts 2 and 3 need a component approach. Part 1 needs exactly one effective temporal and allocation value. Preserve the source-supported scientific content.
Keep StudyPart records flat: each StudyPart item's own part_id must be null. Preserve the source-supported mixed-method content and all valid links to those parts.

Do not map the experimental Australian proxy EQ-HWB-9 version 1 to the base EQ-HWB-S identity. Use an exact reviewed child identity if supplied; otherwise leave registry_id null. Preserve the source-supported scientific content.
